turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Report card week isn't Owen's problem. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me, Hale. I've listened to nothing yet, because you haven't told me who decided on that zero or on what basis.
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kind would have been a phone call before that mark went in. Answer my question, Hale.
